Two compliant Physical-World adapters can therefore consume the same canonical recipe and rotate the moving component around different lines while still honoring every currently documented field. Before articulated hinge/tilt realization becomes authoritative, serialize a project-owned pivot/anchor representation (or explicitly version an equivalent deterministic derivation rule) through an ObjectGenome schema/version decision, then add fixtures/tests that prove identical decoded geometry across adapters.
